_comment_display: 3x QVue display board running rh850-baremetal display_manager (QVUE_9090, release 1.15+ / v01.00+) behind a DS90UH983/DS90UH988 link (hh983-serializer config_mode=2). The IOC at 0x66 sets each FPGA output's backlight level (OUT_REQ 0x0240+4i); the daemon drives all three with one level. Units still on the stock firmware or qvue_legacy use config_null_qvue_3x.json (vendor protocol at 0x32) instead; als-dimmer-select-config.sh picks between the two.
_comment_sensor: The QVue has no ambient light sensor, so sensor.type=null: the daemon boots straight into MANUAL mode and is driven over its socket (Stream Deck brightness keys, disp-settings). AUTO mode is refused with SENSOR_UNAVAILABLE. The zones below are required by the config schema but unused.
_comment_output: qvue_ioc: value_range is display_manager's FPGA level, 1:1 with MAX 0x07FF, half the stock host scale. The backlight lights from about 12-16 counts (rig 2026-11-04, i1 full white: 12 -> 1.8, 16 -> 14, 20 -> 35, 30 -> 83, 40 -> 115, 0x100 -> 868 nits), so [20, 2047] with response_exponent 2.2 is the stock config's [40, 4095] curve: 0 % = off (off_at_zero), 1 % = raw 20 (~35 nits), 50 % = raw ~461, 100 % = raw 2047. The firmware derates output 0 on its own (thermal bands); the daemon writes the request, the firmware applies what the derating allows. Every write is guarded and read back (983/988 0x67 rule).
_comment_calibration: calibrations/qvue_ioc_3x.csv is the stock table (qvue_3x.csv) on this scale: the same percent gives about the same light. i1 spot checks 2026-11-04 through the daemon: within 10 % from 1 % to 40 %.
